died.name: Chongzhen Emperor
died.desc: the last emperor of Ming dynasty
died.last_words: It has been seventeen years since I ascended the throne. I, feeble and of small virtue, have offended against Heaven; the rebels have seized my capital because my ministers deceived me. Ashamed to face my ancestors, I die. Removing my imperial cap and with my hair disheveled about my face, I leave to the rebels the dismemberment of my body. Let them not harm my people!

died.name: François Vatel
died.cause: The majordomo of Prince Louis II de Bourbon-Condè was responsible for a banquet for 2,000 people hosted in honour of King Louis XIV at the Château de Chantilly, where he died. According to a letter by Madame de Sévigné, Vatel was so distraught about the lateness of the seafood delivery and about other mishaps, that he committed suicide with his sword, and his body was discovered when someone came to tell him of the arrival of the fish.

died.name: Athanasios Diakos
died.cause: prior to execution for refusal to convert from Christianity to Islam and become an Ottoman officer
died.last_words: I was born a Greek, I shall die a Greek.

died.name: Lucy Maud Montgomery
died.cause: conclusion of note found on her bedside table after her death. It may or may not have been a suicide note
died.last_words: I have lost my mind by spells and I do not dare think what I may do in those spells. May God forgive me and I hope everyone else will forgive me even if they cannot understand. My position is too awful to endure and nobody realizes it. What an end to a life in which I tried always to do my best.

died.name: Vladimir Komarov
died.cause: final transmission before fatal crash of Soyuz 1 spacecraft
died.last_words: Thank you for transmitting all of that. [Separation] occurred. [garbled]

died.name: Pete Ham
died.cause: written on a suicide note before hanging himself
died.last_words: Anne, I love you. Blair, I love you. I will not be allowed to love and trust everybody. This is better. Pete. P.S. Stan Polley is a soulless bastard. I will take him with me.

born.name: William the Silent
born.last_words: God have mercy upon me, and upon this poor nation.

born.name: Morgan Earp
born.cause: to his brother Wyatt; the brothers had each promised to describe to the other what he saw at the moment of death
born.last_words: I can't see a damned thing.
